dedupe_keys.name: nyc housing maintenance code complaints and problems hpd

description: The public complaints that HPD records about conditions violating the New York City Housing Maintenance Code or the New York State Multiple Dwelling Law, published on NYC Open Data by the city's Department of Housing Preservation and Development. Each row is a problem inside a complaint, with received date, problem and complaint IDs, building ID, borough, address, block, lot, apartment, unit and space type, major and minor category, problem code, complaint and problem status with dates, duplicate and anonymous flags, latitude and longitude, council district, census tract, building identification number, tax lot and neighbourhood. The dataset is updated daily and the portal showed 16,336,600 rows when queried, with the latest update on 28 September 2026 and public release in 2023. Coverage: New York City. Licence: not stated in the dataset metadata; access is free through the portal or API. Caveats: complaints reflect who reports, so they undercount problems in buildings where tenants do not complain, and duplicates are flagged, not removed. Useful as a large record of residential building condition, for example heating failures during cold or heat events, for resilience, condition and capacity planning; related records are not yet linked.
